svg.title: Go HTTP stack performance comparison
svg.desc: Median HTTP/1.1 loopback requests per second and in-process handler operations per second, with observed sample ranges for GoForj Web, net/http, Echo, Gin, Chi, Gorilla Mux, and httprouter.
svg.text: Equivalent endpoint work using idiomatic APIs · medians with observed ranges · not a ranking
Single-core end-to-end requests/sec · reused keep-alive connection
In-process ops/sec · paired added latency vs the same sample's plaintext route
go1.26.10 · darwin/arm64 · Apple M4 Max · GOMAXPROCS=1 · median of 7 samples · benchtime=1s · revision aeab43e925d4
Loopback is HTTP/1.1 req/s; other panels are in-process ServeHTTP ops/s. Small differences and overlapping ranges are not rankings.
Environment: Kernel Darwin 25.5.0 · CGO_ENABLED=1 · GOARM64=v8.0 · GODEBUG=(unset) · GOEXPERIMENT=(unset) · GOFLAGS=(unset)
Dependencies: net/http go1.26.10 · GoForj Web local checkout · Echo v5.4.4 · Gin v1.12.0 · Chi v5.5.0 · Gorilla Mux v1.8.1 · httprouter v1.3.0
